links.comparator_used: LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone, with no uncertainty score
links.outcome: Discrimination of LLM extraction failure (disagreement with expert CCTA annotations)
links.quote: LLM uncertainty was strongly associated with extraction failure (adjusted OR 4.15 [95% CI 2.57--6.69], $P<0.001$) and substantially improved discrimination beyond LLM-extracted CCTA stenosis severity alone (AUC 0.81 to 0.86; $Δ$AUC $+0.06$ [$+0.03$, $+0.09$], $P=0.001$).

design_hint: LLM uncertainty-based flagging of extraction failures
